title: Adapter Bundle
description: M9.0 operator-mediated request/response envelope for adapters that cannot reach the layer directly (web agents, restricted environments). Encodes the six contract operations as a single JSON object so a web agent can paste/produce it in a chat surface. Two directions: layer-to-adapter (import; carries context/decisions/task) and adapter-to-layer (export; carries append_decisions / submit_results). Direction-specific shape is enforced by M9.1's ingest code — at the schema level only common fields are required so a single schema validates both directions. Embedded payloads (context, decisions[], task, results) are checked against their own canonical schemas at ingest time (context-snapshot, decision-entry, worker-task, worker-result); this schema checks the envelope only. See docs/m9-adapter-pattern.md.

bundle_id.description: Stable identifier for this bundle (e.g. 'bundle-2026-05-25-abc123'). Used by ingest logs and audit trails.

direction.description: layer-to-adapter = import bundle generated by the layer for an adapter to consume; adapter-to-layer = export bundle produced by an adapter for the operator to ingest.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the bundle was minted.

for_adapter.description: Direction layer-to-adapter only: the adapter this bundle was generated for. Ingest validates this against core/schemas/adapter-identity.schema.json; this envelope schema requires only that it be an object.

from_adapter.description: Direction adapter-to-layer only: the adapter that produced this bundle. Ingest validates against core/schemas/adapter-identity.schema.json.

allowed_operations.description: Direction layer-to-adapter only: contract operations the recipient may exercise in its eventual return bundle.

context.description: Direction layer-to-adapter: embedded context-snapshot. Ingest validates against core/schemas/context-snapshot.schema.json.

decisions.description: Direction layer-to-adapter: decision-entry objects (newest-first by convention). Each item is validated against core/schemas/decision-entry.schema.json at ingest.

task.description: Direction layer-to-adapter: at most one worker-task assigned to the recipient (or null). Ingest validates against core/schemas/worker-task.schema.json.

instructions.description: Direction layer-to-adapter: operator-provided guidance for the recipient (e.g. 'Read the context and return an adapter-to-layer bundle.').

append_decisions.description: Direction adapter-to-layer: WorkerDecisionDraft objects the recipient wants appended to the decision log. Routed through _decisions.append_entries_from_worker on ingest — the same path as M8.3 worker-result writeback, so all M8.3 / M8.3.1 invariants apply (all-or-nothing validation, auto-injected provenance, never bypasses the canonical writer).

submit_results.description: Direction adapter-to-layer: array of submit packages, each containing a task_id and a worker-result. Routed through worker.sh submit semantics on ingest, preserving the M4 handoff ledger invariants.

notes.description: Direction adapter-to-layer: optional human-readable summary the recipient included for the operator.

bundle_claim.description: M9.1: present in layer-to-adapter bundles that include a task, and echoed back in the adapter-to-layer return bundle so ingest can correlate the two and detect task state changes between export and ingest. task_hash is sha256 of the canonical JSON of the task at export time; ingest re-computes against the on-disk task and rejects the bundle if they differ. The operator-mediated claim flow at ingest (queued -> claimed -> running -> submit on behalf of bundle:<adapter_id>) treats this metadata as the authority on which task this bundle represents.

task_hash.description: sha256 hex of canonical (sort_keys, no whitespace) JSON of the task at export time.

exported_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the export captured the task.
